parts.problem_md:
The table shows the population, correct to two significant figures, of each of six countries in April 2016.

| Country | Population (April 2016) |
|---|---|
| Hungary | 9.8×10<sup>6</sup> |
| Mexico | 1.3×10<sup>8</sup> |
| Thailand | 6.8×10<sup>7</sup> |
| Nigeria | 1.9×10<sup>8</sup> |
| Singapore | 5.7×10<sup>6</sup> |
| Egypt | 9.3×10<sup>7</sup> |

Write 9.3×10<sup>7</sup> as an ordinary number.
parts.solution_md:
> *Use place value to convert out of standard form by by multiplying 9.3 by 10 000 000 (which is equivalent to *$10^{7}$*)*

> *One power of 10 turns 9.3 to 93, and then you need 6 zeroes after that for the other 6 powers of 10*

**Final answer:** **93 000 000**

**[B1]**

parts.problem_md: Which of these countries had the least population?
parts.solution_md:
> *First look for the numbers with the smallest power of 10*

$9.8\times10^{6}$* (Hungary)*

$5.7\times10^{6}$* (Singapore)*

> *Then select the number with the smallest starting value*

$5.7<9.8$

**Final answer:** **Singapore**

parts.problem_md:
The population of China was 1.382×10<sup>9</sup> in April 2016.
The population of India was 1.327×10<sup>9</sup> in April 2016.

Work out the difference between the population of China and the population of India in April 2016.
Give your answer in standard form.
parts.solution_md:
> *Use subtraction to calculate the difference in populations (a calculator can be used to solve the calculation)*

$1.382\times10^{9}-1.327\times10^{9}=55000000$

**[M1]**

> *Write the answer in standard form by dividing by powers of 10 until the decimal point is placed between the first two digits*

![Mathematical division of 55,000,000 by 10 million with arrows indicating place value adjustment, resulting in an unclear figure.](assets/001-mathematical-division-of-55-000-000-by-10-millio.png)

$5.5\times10^{7}$

**[A1]**

parts.problem_md:
The number of neurons in a human brain is $8.5\times10^{10}$
The number of neurons in a monkey brain is $1.47\times10^{9}$

The number of neurons in a human brain is $K\times$ the number of neurons in a monkey brain.

Work out the value of $K$
Give your answer correct to one decimal place.
parts.solution_md:
> $K$* is the number of times the number of neurons in a monkey brain needs to be multiplied to get the number of neurons in a human brain. Use the inverse operation to work it out*

`open parentheses 8.5 space cross times space 10 to the power of 10 close parentheses space divided by space open parentheses 1.47 space cross times space 10 to the power of 9 close parentheses`

**[M1]**

$=57.82...$

> *Round to 1 decimal place*

$57.8$

**[A1]**
